ranked.headline: Graph learning predicts biomolecular interactions and drug responses from omics data
ranked.summary: Graph-structured models are being applied to interaction, drug-response, and single-cell regulatory prediction with added interpretability.

ranked.headline: Deep learning segments and annotates cells across MRI, microscopy and pathology images
ranked.summary: Standardized challenge benchmarks and released tooling now expose where biomedical imaging models generalize across cohorts and modalities.

ranked.headline: Coupled mechanical models link cell confinement, cytokinetic flow and tissue forces
ranked.summary: Three preprints pair cell-scale mechanical models with a second physical process and an explicit route to data.

ranked.headline: ML models treat immunogenicity as an explicit design and prediction objective
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair affinity optimization with explicit immunogenicity readouts across antibodies, peptides, and neoepitopes.

ranked.headline: Software toolkits for impedance sensing, single-cell DNA, and integration-site analysis
ranked.summary: Four December 2025 preprints release open-source software for impedance, single-cell DNA, integration-site, and plate-design data analysis.

ranked.headline: Genome and metagenome mining links sequence content to microbial trait classes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply broad genome and metagenome sampling to assign specific trait classes to microbial sequence diversity.

ranked.headline: Software reconciles platform-specific omics outputs with downstream analysis
ranked.summary: Six new preprints release open tools that standardize vendor and search-engine outputs for downstream omics analysis.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking Sampling and Scoring Strategies for Protein-Ligand Binding Prediction
ranked.summary: Side-by-side benchmarks of pose, affinity, and free energy methods now test GPU-accelerated and deep learning predictors against shared references.

ranked.headline: Adapting pretrained protein and molecular models to stability and design tasks
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence and structure models are being coupled with physical constraints, simulation, and experimental stability data for design and prediction.

ranked.headline: Diagnostic scrutiny of molecular binding and stability models for shortcuts and shift
ranked.summary: Recent work tests whether affinity and stability models generalize beyond shortcut exploitation on public benchmarks and held-out protein families.

ranked.headline: Long-read tools target reference bias, phasing switch errors, and variant benchmarking
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers report reference-genome choice, haplotype-resolved assembly, and benchmark resources shaping variant calling accuracy.

ranked.headline: Computational antigen assignment for T cells and tumor peptide presentation
ranked.summary: Single-cell pMHC assays and immunopeptidomics now support sequencing-scale antigen assignment and prioritization in immunity and cancer.

ranked.headline: Individual fMRI-based brain models and multivariate network comparison across subjects
ranked.summary: Recent work infers individual brain connectivity from fMRI co-activity and compares subject-specific network configurations directly.

ranked.headline: Scalable and federated methods extend GWAS modelling, heritability and ancestry inference
ranked.summary: Federated, scalable and ancestry-aware methods address privacy and computational limits in complex-trait genetic analysis.

ranked.headline: Physics- and substructure-aware graph models predict protein and molecular properties
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs substructure annotations and physics or dynamics priors with graph and transformer architectures for protein and molecular prediction.

ranked.headline: Defense and anti-defense turnover co-evolve across bacterial genomic compartments
ranked.summary: Population-scale sequence data now resolve accessory and mobile genetic turnover across bacteria, phages, and vaccine-targeted pathogens.

ranked.headline: Generative and multi-omic tools now map and design neuronal and regulatory states
ranked.summary: Resolving neuronal and regulatory state beyond bulk gene-level measurements now extends to isoforms, single cells, and designed enhancers.

ranked.headline: Simulations link nucleosome and condensate binding to residue-level molecular features
ranked.summary: Simulations now tie binding and partitioning outcomes to specific residues and sequence features in nucleosome and condensate systems.

ranked.headline: NMR restraints and force-field checks refine conformational ensembles of RNA and proteins
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair NMR data, chemical probing and microsecond MD with force-field benchmarks to test how well simulated ensembles match experiment.

ranked.headline: Models decode spatial tissue organization from imaging and spatial transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Spatially resolved histology, multiplexed imaging and spot-based transcriptomics now demand computational models that preserve tissue architecture.

ranked.headline: Learned models link microbial genomes and literature to biosynthetic function
ranked.summary: Pan-genomic deep learning, literature mining, and ML-guided engineering now address microbial biosynthesis from sequence to application.

ranked.headline: Protein, mRNA and DNA language models target fitness, design and genomic prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend autoregressive and GPT-style pretraining to protein families, mRNA coding sequences and cross-kingdom genomes.

ranked.headline: Pangenomes expose structural variants behind Tibetan adaptation and peanut oil chemistry
ranked.summary: Near-complete and graph pangenomes now capture structural variation that links to adaptation, oil chemistry, and disease risk loci.

ranked.headline: Optimal control and phage dynamics shape bacterial eradication strategies
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model biofilm eradication, phage-antibiotic combinations, and phage-bacteria clearance to design intervention schedules.

ranked.headline: Distinguishing intrinsic criticality from latent drive in spiking and EEG models
ranked.summary: Perturbation-response tests can separate intrinsic criticality from latent-input correlations, and metabolic and EEG-based models add new constraints.

ranked.headline: Neuroscience analysis methods are being packaged as web-accessible, interactive tools
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published toolbox deliver neuroscience analyses as interactive, browser-based, or packaged software for wider use.

ranked.headline: Learned representations tie spatial omics integration to explicit tissue structure
ranked.summary: Spatial omics methods now align, integrate, and encode subcellular and multimodal data within explicit spatial and relational frameworks.

ranked.headline: Machine learning steers binder and epitope design against viral and pathogen targets
ranked.summary: Computational design and prioritisation now reach experimental validation for viral receptor-binding domains and antibody-linked pathogen targets.

ranked.headline: Learned models extend variant prediction to noncoding, organellar, and RNA contexts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published caller apply deep learning to regulatory, mitochondrial, protein interaction, and long-read RNA variant questions.

ranked.headline: MD Simulations Map Modulators and Aggregation-Prone Regions in Amyloidogenic Proteins
ranked.summary: Recent all-atom and enhanced-sampling simulations resolve residue-level determinants of aggregation in Tau, α-synuclein, Aβ40, and myocilin.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic state structure and physical bounds constrain models of cellular dynamics
ranked.summary: Calibrated, experimentally parameterized mechanistic models now address promoter, stress-response, metabolic, and aging dynamics.

ranked.headline: Transposon enhancers and acrocentric chromosome evolution across mammalian genomes
ranked.summary: Expanded mammalian and great ape genome comparisons now resolve regulatory element origins, chromosome architecture changes, and microRNA orthology.

ranked.headline: Algorithmic redesigns of alignment and search target throughput and memory limits
ranked.summary: Four unreviewed preprints report alignment and search methods for short tandem repeats, multi-genome databases, barcoding, and long-read assembly.

ranked.headline: Simulations probe how ligands and carbon dots bind RNA and DNA
ranked.summary: Explicit polarization and extended MD now probe RNA/DNA binding sites, while AF3 benchmarks ssDNA structure prediction.

ranked.headline: Structure-derived descriptors assess AlphaFold model quality and domain environments
ranked.summary: Whole-proteome AlphaFold-DB screening and pLDDT fragmentation analyses are emerging alongside residue network comparisons of remote homologous domains.

ranked.headline: Network and generative models of AML treatment response and drug design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method apply explicit network and generative models to AML treatment and drug design.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models of cell cooling, ciliary flow, and sperm subpopulation composition
ranked.summary: Computational and mathematical models are being applied to cryopreservation, embryo pathogen defense, and sperm subpopulation composition in recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Model assumptions govern what single-cell snapshot data can support
ranked.summary: Preprints show omitted biology such as cell growth and unmodeled time structure distort inferences from single-cell and spatial snapshot data.

ranked.headline: Noise and distributed delay prolong metastability in bistable gene circuits
ranked.summary: Stochastic models now quantify how delays, noise and network topology set persistence and timing limits in bistable and cascade regulatory systems.

ranked.headline: Construction choices reshape single-cell benchmark and embedding performance
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test how feature partitioning, batch structure and negative sampling affect single-cell performance and representation quality.
